sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages seventy-eight to eighty-three, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: mirror and light distances, the legal tread depth, crash-injury percentages and the trooper call code are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none open; the interchange drawings on physical page seventy-nine and the equipment picture on physical page eighty-two were not read as pictures, so the directional-ramp example tied to the drawing was left out and equipment facts come from the running text; the child-restraint sentence that begins on physical page eighty-one and ends on eighty-two is cited to the page where it begins.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
